title: The Bridge Troll
description: The troll at the old stone bridge takes something off everyone who crosses, and kills the ones who argue. A trader lost a wheel and half his stock last week. Mill Brook wants the arrangement ended.

objectives.description: End the troll's toll at the stone bridge

notes: Threat: a toll-taking troll on the only bridge Mill Brook has, that bargains rather than simply killing - it wants payment, and people who pay walk away. Giver motive: the village would rather end the arrangement than keep feeding it. Refusal: the toll keeps being paid in wheels, stock and rings, and eventually in an argument someone loses. Second path (paying the toll or bargaining it down) is the obvious other resolution and is not wired in this file - no choice_consequences exists to extend and the objective is kill-only; flagged for a later pass rather than invented here.
